attchmntText: Rays of Belief Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
voiceSummary: Rays of Belief Limited intimates the termination of Dr. Vivek Gupta, Medical Director and Senior Management Personnel, effective closing hours of November 18, 2026. The cessation results from organizational restructuring by the Company, rendering the Medical Director position unnecessary under the revised structure. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Please find enclosed Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Rays of Belief Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by CARE Ratings Limited. The report confirms that IPO proceeds were utilized as per the offer document with no deviation. Pre-IPO proceeds of Rs. 5.895 crore were fully utilized for General Corporate Purpose. The Board ratified this utilization on September 04, 2026. Unutilized proceeds of Rs. 8.584 crore are parked in the current account of Mom’s Belief US, Inc. The company raised Rs. 124.997 crore via IPO in September 2026 and Rs. 5.895 crore via Pre-IPO placement earlier in 2026.

Rays of Belief Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
